question: What is the annual leave entitlement?
expected_answer: Full-time employees get 20 days of paid annual leave per year.

question: How many sick leave days are allowed?
expected_answer: Employees may take up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year.

question: Is retaliation against a complainant prohibited?
expected_answer: Yes. The Company prohibits retaliation against anyone who reports or participates in an investigation of alleged wrongdoing.
